title: Trip to Kyoto

lines.en: Hi Chloe, welcome back! How was Kyoto?
lines.zh: 嗨 Chloe，歡迎回來！京都怎麼樣？

lines.en: Wonderful, but I'm still a little tired.
lines.zh: 很棒，不過我還是有點累。

lines.en: A temple on a hill. I happened to run into a friendly guide.
lines.zh: 山丘上的一間寺廟。我剛好碰到一位很親切的導遊。

lines.en: Did you plan everything before you left?
lines.zh: 你出發前有把一切都規劃好嗎？

lines.en: I made an itinerary, but the trains were confusing.
lines.zh: 我做了行程表，但電車很讓人搞不懂。

lines.en: Oh no. Did you get lost?
Yes! It took me an hour to figure out the map.
lines.zh: 有！我花了一個小時才弄懂地圖。

lines.en: Ha! You could end up in the wrong city that way.
lines.zh: 哈！那樣搞不好會跑到錯的城市去。

lines.en: Almost! But a kind woman helped me.
lines.zh: 差一點！不過一位好心的女士幫了我。

lines.en: I found a great noodle shop. I went back three times.
lines.zh: 我找到一家很棒的麵店，回去吃了三次。

lines.en: What would you recommend for the best time to go?
lines.zh: 你會建議什麼時候去最好？

lines.en: Mid-November. The red leaves are beautiful then.
lines.zh: 十一月中旬。那時候的紅葉很美。

lines.en: Sounds perfect. I'll go next autumn.
lines.zh: 聽起來太棒了。我明年秋天就去。

quiz.q: What was difficult for Chloe at first?
quiz.why: Chloe 說她做了行程表，但電車很讓人搞不懂。

quiz.q: How many times did Chloe go back to the noodle shop?
When does Chloe suggest going to Kyoto?
quiz.why: 她說十一月中旬的紅葉很美。

words.ex1: A temple on a hill. I happened to run into a friendly guide.
words.ex2: I ran into our supplier at the trade show last week.
words.ex2zh: 我上週在展覽上巧遇我們的供應商。

words.ex1: Ha! You could end up in the wrong city that way.

words.ex2zh: 如果我們跳過測試，最後可能會有更多瑕疵品。
words.hook: end 終點＋up：一路走到終點，最後停在哪裡＝最後落得
words.pic: a confused traveler standing at the end of a winding road in front of the wrong city sign

words.ex1: Yes! It took me an hour to figure out the map.
words.ex2: We need to figure out why the machine keeps stopping.
words.ex2zh: 我們得查出這台機器為什麼一直停機。
words.hook: figure 是「圖形、數字」：把圖（數字）算出來（out）＝弄清楚
words.pic: a person looking at a big map with a light bulb above their head

words.ex1: I made an itinerary, but the trains were confusing.
words.ex2: Please send me your itinerary before the business trip.
words.ex2zh: 出差前請把你的行程表寄給我。
words.hook: 拆字：itiner 來自拉丁文 iter（旅程）＋ary（表）＝旅程表＝行程表
words.pic: a happy young traveler with a backpack holding a big schedule card showing only small pictures of a plane, a train and a hotel connected by a dotted line

words.ex1: What would you recommend for the best time to go?
words.ex2: I recommend that we check every board twice.
words.ex2zh: 我建議每片電路板都檢查兩次。
words.hook: 拆字：re（一再）＋commend（稱讚）＝一直稱讚它＝推薦
words.pic: a smiling person giving a thumbs up and pointing at a bowl of noodles

part2.q: When is the shipment leaving the factory?
opts: Yes, it was a long trip.
part2.why: 問 When（何時），要回答時間。B 是地點（Where 的答案），A 的 trip 跟 ship 聯想是陷阱。
part2.zh: 這批貨什麼時候離開工廠？

part2.q: Could you send me the meeting schedule?
part2.why: Could you 是請求，答 Sure 最自然。B 重複 meeting 是陷阱，C 的 No 不通順。
part2.zh: 你可以把會議時間表寄給我嗎？

part2.q: Why don't we move the meeting to Friday?
part2.why: Why don't we 是建議，不是真的問原因。That works for me 是同意。A 把它當成 Why 來回答是陷阱。
part2.zh: 我們何不把會議改到星期五？

part2.q: Do you want tea or coffee?
opts: I just came from the store.
part2.why: 選擇問句（A or B）不能用 Yes/No 回答，直接選一個。

part2.q: Who is in charge of the training session?
opts: Ms. Lin from the HR team.
part2.why: 問 Who（誰），要回答人。B 是地點，C 是時間長度。

scene: Chloe 剛從京都旅行回來，Oliver 在辦公室問她旅途的種種。

grammar.topicZh: 詞性（名詞／形容詞／副詞的位置）
grammar.tip: 先看空格的位置：a/the 後面要名詞；名詞前面放形容詞；修飾動詞用副詞（常是 -ly）；be 動詞後面通常接形容詞。

items.q: Please read the safety rules _____ before you start the machine.
items.why: 空格修飾動詞 read（怎麼讀），要用副詞 carefully。careful 是形容詞，只能修飾名詞。
items.zh: 開機器前請仔細閱讀安全規定。

items.q: The new packaging design is very _____.
items.why: be 動詞 is＋very 後面要形容詞，描述主詞的樣子：attractive（吸引人的）。
items.zh: 新的包裝設計很吸引人。

items.q: We received a _____ from the customer this morning.
items.why: 冠詞 a 後面要接名詞，complaint 是名詞（客訴）；complain 是動詞。
items.zh: 我們今天早上收到客戶的一封客訴。

items.q: The engineers worked _____ to fix the problem before the deadline.
items.why: 修飾動詞 worked（怎麼工作），要用副詞 quickly。
items.zh: 工程師們很快地工作，在期限前修好問題。

items.q: Our team made a _____ decision after the meeting.
items.why: a ___ decision：冠詞和名詞中間要放形容詞 final（最後的）。
items.zh: 我們團隊在會後做出最後決定。
